project.name: tingting
project.description: TingTing — a Vietnamese trucking logistics platform structured as a pnpm monorepo: an Express 5 + TypeScript backend, a React 19 + Vite frontend styled with Tailwind CSS, and a shared package, with Drizzle ORM, JWT+Casbin RBAC, and Docker-based deployment.

nodes.name: context-manifest.json
nodes.summary: Codex agent context-routing manifest with nine workspace profiles (product-planning, backend-api, database, shared-contracts, financial, frontend, agent-runtime, deployment, documentation) that map changed file paths to required context docs and QA commands.

nodes.name: hooks.json
nodes.summary: Codex hook registration that fires when a TaskUpdate marks a task completed, prompting the agent to refresh HANDOFF.md with goal, changed files, gotchas, and next steps.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Docker build-context exclusion list that keeps dependency dirs, git/agent state, uploads, tests, coverage, docs, plans, and env files out of the backend/frontend production images so builds stay small and secret-free.

nodes.name: config.json
nodes.summary: ZCode configuration that enables config-file hooks and registers the Stop event handler running the understand-staleness freshness check at the end of every turn.

nodes.name: understand-staleness.sh
nodes.summary: Fail-safe Stop hook that compares the knowledge base's recorded git commit in meta.json against HEAD and, when stale and auto-update is enabled, injects an instruction to run the Understand-Anything incremental update flow.
nodes.languageNotes: Exports HOOK_CTX as a real environment variable before invoking node — passing it after `-e` as argv leaves process.env.HOOK_CTX undefined and silently drops the injected context.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Mandatory working contract for every coding agent in the repo: trunk-based git on main only (no branches/worktrees/PRs), skill selection rules, progressive context loading via pnpm context, the closed-loop SDLC with QA gates and fix-loop rules, mandatory qa/ artifacts, and the Understand-Anything knowledge-base upkeep duty.

nodes.name: CONTEXT.md
nodes.summary: Compact development-context entrypoint defining the source authority order, the repository shape (shared/backend/frontend/e2e plus docs, plans, qa, deploy), the progressive context-loading protocol driven by pnpm context, and the HANDOFF.md task-state convention.

nodes.name: HANDOFF.example.md
nodes.summary: Tracked template for the git-ignored HANDOFF.md task-state snapshot, covering goal, scope and non-goals, decisions with sources, task-owned files, preserved concurrent changes, QA artifact references, and the next step.

nodes.name: Makefile
nodes.summary: Root orchestration for the whole dev lifecycle: brings up the docker-compose dev stack, runs Drizzle migrations and seeds, starts backend :3001 and frontend :7174 with stale-PID cleanup, and ships the demo deployment to vantai.tingting.vip via GHCR images with rollback capture and public readiness checks.
nodes.languageNotes: 21 make targets sharing a DEMO_COMPOSE indirection so every demo-* target reuses one compose invocation; SSH-driven remote orchestration records pre-cutover image IDs before each deployment for rollback.

nodes.name: ROADMAP.md
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for what to build next: a wave-ordered plan (Foundation shipments entity, Pricing/Fuel, CUS core, Financial Close, Mobile/Director Reporting) mapped onto the 12 Vietnamese PRD modules, with per-wave checklists, a PRD coverage matrix, and open-question tracking against the accepted Q01-Q23 business-logic defaults.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Docker build-context allowlist for the backend image: starts from an ignore-all pattern and re-admits exactly the workspace manifests, shared sources, backend sources, and drizzle migrations the backend Dockerfile COPYs, excluding tests and spec files.
nodes.languageNotes: Inverted-deny pattern ('*' then targeted '!unignore' rules) keeps the root context usable for pnpm workspace linking while shrinking the transmitted build context.

nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Template of backend runtime environment variables covering ports, database/Redis URLs, JWT auth, OCR providers (OpenRouter Qwen3-VL with Gemini fallback), Bách Khoa GPS tracking, Map4D geocoding, VAPID web push, and the disabled MiniMax command bot.
nodes.languageNotes: Several formerly-configurable values (MiniMax model, OpenRouter base URL, call timeouts) are deliberately hardcoded in services and documented as such here; providers self-enable via non-empty keys rather than boolean flags.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Two-stage backend image: a node:22-alpine builder stage activates pnpm, installs workspace deps with cache mounts, and compiles shared+backend TypeScript; the production stage copies only built output, pruned node_modules, casbin policy files, drizzle migrations, and Vietnamese fonts, then serves on port 3090.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses BuildKit cache mounts for pnpm store and tsc incremental builds, plus pnpm deploy-style injection of workspace packages into a prunable /prod tree.

nodes.name: Dockerfile.dockerignore
nodes.summary: Docker build-context allowlist for the backend image, whitelisting only the pnpm workspace manifests, shared and backend source trees, drizzle SQL migrations, and the two BeVietnamPro font files needed by PDF generation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses an inverted-deny pattern: `*` excludes everything, then `!path` re-includes allowlisted entries while nested re-exclusions strip tests and unwanted drizzle artifacts.

nodes.name: Makefile
nodes.summary: Backend build-and-release pipeline: builds and pushes the ghcr.io/4rankng/transting-backend image via docker buildx with registry cache, provides a fast local build, and dry-run/apply targets for linking orphan driver profiles to user accounts.
nodes.languageNotes: Tags images with a source tag computed at recipe-expansion time via `$(shell node scripts/release-source-tag.mjs)`; GHCR auth falls back to piping `gh auth token` into docker login.

nodes.name: drizzle.config.ts
nodes.summary: drizzle-kit configuration pointing at src/db/schema.ts for PostgreSQL migrations emitted to ./drizzle, defaulting to the project's port-5441 silversea database via DATABASE_URL.

nodes.name: 0000_flexible-baseline.sql
nodes.summary: Baseline database schema creating the entire TingTing logistics platform in one migration: 124 tables spanning shipments, trips, billing, ledger, treasury, payroll, fleet, fuel, governance, RBAC and AI-knowledge domains, plus ~240 supporting indexes.
nodes.languageNotes: Enables pgvector and unaccent extensions for RAG search; uses partial unique indexes extensively to enforce soft-delete, supersession and active-row invariants.

nodes.name: 0001_backfill_shipment_readiness.sql
nodes.summary: Idempotent data migration that reclassifies legacy NEW shipments into the 2026 dispatch workflow states (IN_TRANSIT, PENDING_EXPENSE_APPROVAL, DISPATCHED, READY_FOR_DISPATCH, PENDING_DATE) inferred from trip statuses and scheduling dates, writing a status-history row per transition.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-pass CTE classification piped through UPDATE ... RETURNING into an INSERT on shipment_status_history; safe to rerun.

nodes.name: 0002_carrier_readiness_authorities.sql
nodes.summary: Introduces external-carrier readiness: creates carrier_fleet_vehicles and shipment_accounting_locks tables, sets the shipments default status to PENDING_DATE, and adds planned external-carrier columns to shipment_fulfillments and trips.

nodes.name: 0003_majestic_clea.sql
nodes.summary: Adds order-exchange tracking columns (started/completed timestamps and actors) to the shipments table.

nodes.name: 0004_tranquil_chronomancer.sql
nodes.summary: Creates CUS container charge, document custody and recovery fact tables, and extends shipment_accounting_locks with release/confirmation workflow columns plus planned external-carrier vehicle details on fulfillments.

nodes.name: 0005_cus_container_customer_appointment.sql
nodes.summary: Single-column migration adding customer_appointment_at to shipment_containers for per-container customer appointments.

nodes.name: 0006_backfill_cus_container_customer_appointment.sql
nodes.summary: Backfills customer_appointment_at on shipment containers from direction-aware coalescing of shipment closing_at and planned_return_at for rows that have scheduling dates.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a CASE on trade_direction (IMPORT vs EXPORT) to pick which scheduling timestamp becomes the appointment.

nodes.name: 0007_backfill_shipment_shipping_line.sql
nodes.summary: Promotes unambiguous per-shipment shipping line names from shipment containers onto parent shipments whose own shipping line is null or blank.
nodes.languageNotes: CTE groups containers by shipment and only updates when exactly one distinct trimmed name exists.

nodes.name: 0008_fair_stephen_strange.sql
nodes.summary: Adds cargo_volume_cbm to shipment containers and a customer_notes text column to shipments.

nodes.name: 0009_neat_doctor_octopus.sql
nodes.summary: Tightens shipments.cargo_volume_cbm precision to numeric(12,3).

nodes.name: 0010_backfill-shipment-document-reference-invariant.sql
nodes.summary: Normalizes historical Bill-of-Lading and booking references by trade direction before the database CHECK enforces the import-Booking / export-Bill rule, trimming whitespace and clearing the disallowed side with a Bill-first fallback for unclassified rows.
nodes.languageNotes: Direction-aware CASE preserves the allowed reference; unclassified rows with a stored Bill keep Bill, matching legacy workspace behavior.

nodes.name: 0011_mean_vulture.sql
nodes.summary: Adds the shipments_document_reference_direction_check constraint making the Bill/Booking direction rule database-enforced: both refs cannot coexist and each direction forbids its disallowed reference.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses IS DISTINCT FROM for NULL-safe direction comparison inside the CHECK.

nodes.name: 0012_sharp_jack_power.sql
nodes.summary: Adds planned_revenue and planned_carrier_cost to shipment fulfillments and an is_combined boolean defaulting to false on shipments.

nodes.name: 0013_backfill-shipment-combined-flag.sql
nodes.summary: Backfills shipments.is_combined to true where any trip recorded a positive revenue_combine charge, preserving the historical meaning of the Vietnamese 'Hàng kết hợp' (combined cargo) indicator.
nodes.languageNotes: Idempotent EXISTS-based UPDATE that only upgrades rows inferred from trip-level combination revenue.

nodes.name: 0014_add-master-data-short-names.sql
nodes.summary: Adds nullable short_name varchar columns to the customers, operational_sites and routes master-data tables.

nodes.name: 0015_backfill-master-data-short-names.sql
nodes.summary: Populates short_name from the trimmed full name on customers, operational_sites and routes wherever the short name is missing or blank.

nodes.name: 0016_require-master-data-short-names.sql
nodes.summary: Makes short_name NOT NULL on customers, operational_sites and routes after the backfill guaranteed non-null values.

nodes.name: 0017_add-short-name-compat-defaults.sql
nodes.summary: Sets an empty-string default on short_name for customers, operational_sites and routes to keep legacy inserts working.

nodes.name: 0018_add-supplier-short-name.sql
nodes.summary: Database migration adding short_name column to suppliers table
nodes.languageNotes: Drizzle ORM migration for adding optional short_name field

nodes.name: 0019_backfill-supplier-short-name.sql
nodes.summary: Data backfill script populating supplier short names from existing names
nodes.languageNotes: One-time data migration to derive short names from full names

nodes.name: 0020_require-supplier-short-name.sql
nodes.summary: Database migration making supplier short_name column required
nodes.languageNotes: Adds NOT NULL constraint after backfill completion

nodes.name: 0021_add-dispatch-zone-classification.sql

nodes.languageNotes: Extends ports table with zone-based categorization

nodes.summary: Data backfill script for dispatch zone classification based on port codes
nodes.languageNotes: Maps Vietnamese ports to geographic zones (Lach Huyen, Hai Phong, etc.)

nodes.name: fix-esm-imports.js
nodes.summary: ESM import resolution script that walks TypeScript files and rewrites .js imports to .ts extensions.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Configures project tooling or runtime behavior for package.json.

nodes.name: agentSocket.ts
nodes.summary: Real-time socket.io transport for the AI command-and-insight assistant: mounts the /agent namespace on the Express HTTP server, authenticates the JWT handshake, rate-limits turns, and routes each message through intent classification into FAQ/lookup/summary/financial-overview/deterministic-report lanes.
nodes.languageNotes: JWT travels in the socket.io handshake (auth.token) rather than a header; per-session memory is char-capped and in-memory only, while durable history stays on REST.

nodes.name: enforcer.ts
nodes.summary: Initializes and exposes the singleton Casbin enforcer built from model.conf and policy.csv, logging the loaded policy count at boot.
nodes.languageNotes: Policy is loaded once at process boot; under tsx watch, policy.csv edits require a process restart to take effect.

nodes.name: model.conf
nodes.summary: Casbin ACL model defining subject/object/action matching with wildcard object and action support under an allow-only policy effect — the authorization grammar behind the platform's RBAC.

nodes.name: policy.csv
nodes.summary: Casbin policy matrix granting the platform roles (ADMIN, MANAGER, ACCOUNTANT, DISPATCHER, DRIVER, OPS, CUS, CUSTOMER) scoped read/write/delete access across resources like trips, shipments, financials, treasury, and dispatch, with inline comments documenting wave-by-wave RBAC decisions.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses //-style comments inside a CSV policy file to record decisions such as keeping dispatch resources separate from broad shipment access.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Central environment configuration: loads dotenv then validates JWT secrets, database/Redis URLs, ports, VAPID push settings, trust-proxy handling, and feature flags through a Zod schema into a typed config object.
nodes.languageNotes: Process-supplied env values deliberately override the local .env file; trust proxy defaults to 1 hop in production so req.ip survives the Docker/nginx bridge.

nodes.name: backfill-faq-embeddings.ts
nodes.summary: One-off backfill script that embeds FAQ entries with NULL embedding vectors via OpenRouter text-embedding-3-small (1536 dims) and writes them with raw SQL; idempotent and re-runnable after new FAQ rows are added.
nodes.languageNotes: Drizzle cannot express pgvector writes, so vectors are written through raw db.execute SQL literals.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Initializes the singleton postgres.js client and the Drizzle ORM instance bound to the full schema; exported as `db`, this is the database entry point for the entire backend.

nodes.name: master-data-name.ts
nodes.summary: Provides the operationalName SQL helper that prefers a master-data row's configured short name while falling back to the full legal name, keeping operational labels safe for rolling deployments and legacy writers.

nodes.name: migrate-trailers.ts
nodes.summary: One-off data migration extracting trailer plates from the trucks table into the dedicated trailers table, linking trucks via current_trailer_id and backfilling trips.trailer_id, all inside a single idempotent transaction.

nodes.name: schema.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the Drizzle PostgreSQL schema, enums, relations, and constraints for the logistics and accounting domain.

nodes.name: errors.ts
nodes.summary: Defines ApiError, the canonical HTTP error class carrying statusCode and optional details; all services and routes throw it instead of ad-hoc error-object patterns.

nodes.name: locked-entity-manifest.ts
nodes.summary: Defines LOCKED_ENTITY_BOUNDARIES manifest that lists entity types requiring governance approval for changes.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Bootstraps the Express API, applies middleware and route mounts, and coordinates graceful process shutdown.
nodes.languageNotes: The telemetry import must stay first — OpenTelemetry auto-instrumentation only patches modules loaded after SDK init under ESM + tsx watch.

nodes.name: format.ts
nodes.summary: Format utility functions for VND currency, dates, HTML escaping, SQL LIKE term escaping, and image type detection.

nodes.name: logger.ts
nodes.summary: Pino structured logger that mixes trace_id and span_id from the active OpenTelemetry span into every log line; routes through pino-pretty in development and newline-delimited JSON in production.
nodes.languageNotes: pino's mixin() hook injects OTel trace context into every record, so logs stay correlatable with traces even for sampled-out (non-recording) spans.

nodes.name: redis.ts
nodes.summary: Redis client singleton plus a request-coalescing cache layer (single-flight gets, version-tracked invalidation, pattern flush, report-cache invalidation) and JWT blacklist helpers used by auth middleware and route caching.
nodes.languageNotes: In-flight promise deduplication prevents cache stampedes; a version counter per key lets invalidation beat racing fills.

nodes.name: role-aliases.test.ts
nodes.summary: Exhaustive unit tests for the CLERK-to-CUS and FORWARDER-to-OPS role alias layer, covering canonicalization, legacy detection, alias-aware equality, and the exported LEGACY_ROLES/MODERN_ROLES constants.

nodes.name: role-aliases.ts
nodes.summary: Backward-compatibility role alias layer mapping legacy CLERK/FORWARDER names to modern CUS/OPS during the RBAC migration window, providing canonicalization, legacy detection, and alias-aware equality helpers.

nodes.name: scoped-by-customer.ts
nodes.summary: Pure row-scope helpers that force CUSTOMER-role queries to the user's linked customer ids, overwriting caller-supplied filters and applying a deny-all sentinel for unlinked accounts; consumed by the customer portal and customer-reachable financial endpoints.
nodes.languageNotes: DENY_ALL_CUSTOMER_ID is a negative sentinel that can never collide with real positive serial ids, so a misconfigured customer user sees zero rows instead of leaking data.

nodes.name: telemetry.ts
nodes.summary: OpenTelemetry SDK bootstrap that configures OTLP or console trace exporters and a ratio-based sampler from environment variables; must be the first import in index.ts.
nodes.languageNotes: Under ESM + tsx watch, auto-instrumentation can only patch modules loaded after this file initializes, hence the first-import contract.

nodes.name: tx.ts
nodes.summary: Provides project implementation behavior through runInTx.

nodes.name: validation.ts
nodes.summary: Converts a failed Zod parse into a 400 ApiError with a 'message (field)' shape consistent with the global error handler.

nodes.name: asyncHandler.ts
nodes.summary: Express wrapper that catches promise rejections from async route handlers and forwards them to the global error handler.

nodes.name: audit.ts
nodes.summary: Audit-logging middleware that maps mutating requests to registered audit events, sanitizes payloads, runs handlers inside an audit request context, and persists material-write audit outcomes (success, conflict, failure) transactionally.
nodes.languageNotes: Audit persistence failure fails the request with a Vietnamese user-facing message, making the audit trail a hard invariant rather than best-effort logging.

nodes.name: auth.ts
nodes.summary: JWT authentication middleware: verifies the bearer token against the Redis blacklist, loads the user with role and customer scope, detects token/customer-scope drift, and attaches req.user for downstream handlers; also provides a signed-URL asset variant and the getUser accessor.

nodes.name: casbin.ts
nodes.summary: Authorization middleware translating HTTP methods to Casbin actions (read/write/delete) against route-scoped resources, plus requireRoles for hard role gates and tripRouteAuthz for trip-scoped checks.
nodes.languageNotes: requireRoles REPLACES the subject's role set rather than stacking with casbinAuthz — stacking the two previously caused 403s for admins.

nodes.name: errorHandler.ts
nodes.summary: Global Express error handler that converts ApiError and unexpected errors into consistent JSON responses, hides internals in production, and logs stack traces.

nodes.name: forwarder.ts
nodes.summary: Middleware that resolves the OPS/forwarder profile for the authenticated user and attaches it to req.forwarder, avoiding repeated lookups per handler.

nodes.name: material-write.ts
nodes.summary: Provides project implementation behavior through listDeclaredMaterialWriteEndpoints, matchDeclaredMaterialWrite, getMaterialWriteContext.

nodes.name: reset-seed.ts
nodes.summary: Development reset utility that clears core business tables in foreign-key-safe order (users included) and then dynamically imports the modular seed to rebuild a fresh demo database.

nodes.name: admin-gps.ts
nodes.summary: Admin GPS endpoints to backfill and recapture real-route GPS trails after Google Directions retirement: durable, idempotent commands with lease-based concurrency, attempt snapshots, and material-write audit outcomes.
nodes.languageNotes: Commands follow a PENDING → EFFECT_APPLIED → SUCCEEDED/FAILED snapshot state machine with a 2-minute lease, so a crashed capture can be safely retried or observed.

nodes.name: agent.ts
nodes.summary: Defines HTTP routing and authorization through agentRoutes.

nodes.name: app-settings.ts
nodes.summary: Governed app-settings router: reads/writes the singleton settings record with optimistic version checks, routes financial-policy changes through the price-config governance workflow, and manages masked email-provider settings with idempotent writes.

nodes.name: auth.ts
nodes.summary: Authentication and user-management router: login with audit and rate awareness, logout with token blacklisting, profile and password change, plus admin-governed user and business-unit CRUD with optimistic locking and idempotent commands.

nodes.name: gps-settings.ts
nodes.summary: Admin GPS integration settings endpoints (GET/PUT) with AES-256-GCM encrypted provider credentials, masked key responses, optimistic-lock updatedAt checks, and cache invalidation on save.

nodes.name: llm-settings.ts

nodes.languageNotes: RBAC is enforced twice: the llm-settings Casbin resource has no policy row (only the ADMIN wildcard matches) plus requireRoles(Role.ADMIN) at mount time.

nodes.name: maps.ts

nodes.name: faq-fast-lane.ts
nodes.summary: FAQ fast path for the agent: tries exact normalized-question matches against faqEntries, then pgvector semantic search with a score floor and margin, skipping the LLM entirely on a confident hit.

nodes.summary: Rule-based Vietnamese intent router that classifies agent messages into navigation, FAQ, summary, financial-overview, deterministic-report, lookup, or general LLM lanes using normalized keyword and page-alias matching.
nodes.languageNotes: All matching runs on diacritic-stripped Vietnamese normalization with weighted page-alias/keyword tables and regex extraction — no LLM call in the routing path.

nodes.name: knowledge-ingest.ts
nodes.summary: Knowledge-base ingestion pipeline: chunks CONTEXT.md and ADR markdown by heading, embeds chunks with the embedding service, and upserts them into the knowledgeChunks pgvector table with content-hash versioning.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown chunking is heading-driven (h1-h4) with paragraph splitting for oversized sections; MD5 content hashes make re-ingestion idempotent.

nodes.name: knowledge-retrieval.ts
nodes.summary: Semantic knowledge retrieval over ingested chunks: Redis-cached query embedding plus pgvector cosine search returning cited snippets to ground the agent's RAG answers.

nodes.name: lookup-lane.ts
nodes.summary: Entity-lookup lane for the agent: runs semantic search across registry entities via semantic-data.service and formats results into Vietnamese rows with per-entity deep-link actions.

nodes.name: orchestrator.ts
nodes.summary: Core agent orchestrator: runs the MiniMax tool-calling loop with role-filtered tools, streams sanitized text deltas, executes readonly tools concurrently, sanitizes structured JSON responses and directives, and persists per-lane conversation turns.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a bounded agentic loop (selectTools → callMiniMaxStream → execute tools → produceFinalAnswer) with Vietnamese-language system prompts, a readonly-tool concurrency cache, and multi-layer output sanitizers that strip internal contract leaks before SSE emission.

nodes.name: rate-limiter.ts
nodes.summary: Redis-backed per-user token-bucket rate limiter for agent chat: atomic INCR+EXPIRE over a 60-second window, failing open when Redis is unavailable or the limit is disabled.
nodes.languageNotes: Fails open by design — a Redis outage must never block the chat agent.

nodes.name: routeMatcher.ts
nodes.summary: SPA route matching utilities: converts frontend path patterns into regexes, matches route keys from paths, and compares routes with numeric-only params for the agent's navigation directives.

nodes.name: semantic-data.service.ts
nodes.summary: Semantic data layer for the agent: a registry of queryable entities (trips, customers, trucks...) with dynamic Drizzle select/where builders powering natural-language search, list, detail, aggregate, and timeline tools.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a declarative SEMANTIC_ENTITIES registry (fields, aliases, searchable columns) compiled into parameterized Drizzle SQL — the LLM's data.* tools map onto these generic query primitives instead of hand-written endpoints.

nodes.name: stream-sanitizer.ts
nodes.summary: Streaming text sanitizer that buffers LLM deltas until it can prove the emission is safe prose — suppressing JSON, internal contract leaks, and reasoning artifacts before they reach the SSE stream.

nodes.name: summary-lane.ts
nodes.summary: Dashboard-summary lane for the agent: composes role-filtered dashboard stats and registry metrics into KPI widgets, anomaly lists, and quick-action chips without an LLM call.

nodes.name: system-prompt.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the agent's Vietnamese system prompt from role context, the currently selected tools, and the user message, embedding the structured-response contract hint.

nodes.name: telemetry.ts

nodes.name: text.ts
nodes.summary: Vietnamese text normalization helper that strips diacritics, converts đ/Đ, lowercases, and collapses whitespace for consistent intent matching.

nodes.name: token-attribution.ts
nodes.summary: Estimates per-component token usage (system prompt, tools catalog, messages, tool results) for each agent turn and formats the attribution line logged for cost tracking.

nodes.name: tool-result-compact.ts
nodes.summary: Tool-result compaction: shrinks oversized tool payloads for the LLM context by dropping empty fields, capping rows with truncation markers, and JSON-cutting at safe string/container boundaries so partial output stays parseable.
nodes.languageNotes: cutAtSafeBoundary implements a mini JSON scanner that finds a truncation point outside string literals and re-closes open containers — truncated payloads remain syntactically valid JSON.

nodes.name: tool-selector.ts
nodes.summary: Per-message tool pruning: selects the subset of role-available tools relevant to the user's message, derives the iteration budget from selection size, and builds cache keys for readonly tool executions.
nodes.languageNotes: Narrowing the advertised tool list per message cuts prompt tokens and helps the model choose correctly; the iteration budget scales down as the selected tool count grows.

nodes.name: tool.registry.ts
nodes.summary: Aggregates all domain tool modules (advances, analyzers, approvals, audit, data, expenses, finance, fleet, knowledge, ledger, payables, receivables, reports, salary, trips, ui) into one registry and resolves the role-scoped tool set plus individual tool lookup.

nodes.name: tool.types.ts
nodes.summary: Agent tool type system: defines AgentToolDef, AgentContext, and ToolResult contracts, the ToolError/ToolForbiddenError error classes, and the defineReadTool factory that wraps ~40 read-only backend functions with zod arg parsing and defense-in-depth role checks.
nodes.languageNotes: defineReadTool is the uniform 10-line recipe for every data tool: zod params are the single validation gate and allowedRoles is re-checked inside execute even though the registry already filtered per role.

nodes.name: advances.ts

nodes.name: docker-compose.prod.yml
nodes.summary: Production compose stack for the vantai.tingting.vip deployment: pgvector/pgvector:pg16 Postgres, Redis 7 with LRU eviction, GHCR backend and frontend images behind loopback-only ports, and an optional Adminer profile, all with health-gated startup ordering.
nodes.languageNotes: Only the frontend (3000), backend (3090), and Adminer (8080) are published on 127.0.0.1 — Postgres and Redis are merely `expose`d to the compose network; the pgvector image is required for the FAQ vector(1536) cosine index.

nodes.name: nginx-frontend.conf
nodes.summary: Nginx server config for the containerized frontend SPA: gzip compression, security headers (X-Frame-Options, nosniff, Referrer-Policy), 1-year immutable caching for Vite-hashed static assets, and an SPA fallback serving index.html for all other routes.
nodes.languageNotes: Cache busting relies on Vite content-hashed filenames, which is why static assets can be marked immutable for a year while index.html is always re-fetched.

nodes.name: nginx-host-vantai.conf
nodes.summary: Host-level nginx reverse proxy for vantai.tingting.vip: routes /api/ and the /socket.io/ assistant transport (WebSocket upgrade, 300s timeouts for long multi-tool turns) to the backend on 127.0.0.1:3090, / to the frontend container on 3000, /adminer/ to 8080, serves /uploads/ from disk, and terminates TLS via Certbot-managed blocks.
nodes.languageNotes: The /socket.io/ location must stay above location / or the polling handshake resolves to the SPA's index.html and the assistant never connects; SSL lines are Certbot-managed and must not be hand-edited.

Captures port-patterns-not-code lessons, the 404-not-403 ownership posture, and integration owners for milestones M8.5/M9.5/M12.3.

nodes.name: 2026-07-26_12-15_context-engineering-system-prompt-extraction.md
nodes.summary: Journal of the context-engineering task that extracted buildSystemPrompt from the agent orchestrator into a composable system-prompt module with golden-parity tests, plus a playbook mapping context-engineering principles to repo code. Records the declined-clarification scope decision, QA gate results, review fixes, and a pre-existing email-service test hang.

nodes.name: 2026-07-26_21-58_trip-image-preview-blob-url.md
nodes.summary: Incident journal for a frontend regression where the shared photoSrc() helper rewrote pending blob: preview URLs into unresolvable /api/photos/ paths, breaking thumbnails on unsaved trip rows. Documents the blob: passthrough fix, red-green QA logs, and the lesson that shared URL helpers need explicit branches for temporary client-only state.

nodes.name: 2026-07-26_22-30_resend-admin-settings-setback-loop.md
nodes.summary: High-severity journal on the admin-managed Resend API key flow: a mutation-audit middleware path would have persisted the plaintext key until redaction was added, explicit-clear was fixed to delete without decrypting, and failed retries now restore FAILED status instead of lingering PENDING. Notes shared-worktree QA noise and the deployment prerequisite of saving the production key in Settings.

nodes.name: 2026-07-31_16-57_customer-workflow-data-cutover-planning.md
nodes.summary: Blocked-status planning journal exposing the split between app state and the customer's source truth: workbook folders mix templates and demo accounting data, and contract variants conflict on settlement rules. Records the preservation contract for user identities, roles, and user_shipment_links rebuilds, plus staging go/no-go requirements.

nodes.name: 2026-08-01-1340-end-to-end-dispatch-workflow.md
nodes.summary: Wrap-up journal for the end-to-end dispatch workflow plan (master data, intake, fulfillment decomposition, driver execution, e-POD, closure, Debit Note export), focused on a messy QA trail of fixture drift, stale test assumptions under the newer LOCKED-plus-e-POD authority rules, and local DB resets. Decision: accept the stricter trip eligibility rule rather than preserve older COMPLETED-based fixtures.

nodes.name: 2026-08-01-o2c-drop-locked-reconciliation.md
nodes.summary: High-severity journal of the Order-to-Cash refactor that deleted TripStatus.LOCKED entirely, making COMPLETED the single terminal state and migrating the photo, zero-revenue, e-POD, and POD-recovery gates into IN_TRANSIT-to-COMPLETED across five atomic phases. Details the Postgres partial-unique-index enum-swap workaround, soft polymorphic carrier columns, and non-waivable photo evidence rules.

nodes.name: 2026-08-08-rbac-menu-restructure-verification.md
nodes.summary: Verification journal for plan 260806-rbac-menu-restructure confirming all 8 role-to-home-route mappings were already implemented (ADMIN/MANAGER to /dashboard, ACCOUNTANT to /accounting, DISPATCHER to /dispatch/master-plan, CUS to /shipments, and so on); only homeForRole() documentation was updated. Records passing typecheck and lint plus the shared getNavItems() data source for mobile parity.

nodes.name: 260728-2327-decorative-at-prefix-login-confusion.md
nodes.summary: Incident journal where a decorative @ prefix on usernames in the desktop and mobile user lists was mistaken for part of the login credential. The fix removed the presentation-only JSX prefixes while keeping the authentication flow and payloads untouched, with a regression test covering both responsive render paths.

nodes.name: 260728-2348-shipment-mobile-bottom-fold.md
nodes.summary: UI-repair journal for the shipments page phone viewport, where the breadcrumb's inherited 44px touch-target height pushed the list footer about 30px below the first fold at 390x844. The narrow fix hides .shipments-page__crumbs below 640px only, preserving shared safe-area and touch rules, with a regression test in ShipmentsPage.test.tsx.

nodes.name: 260729-2038-shipment-operations-workspace.md
nodes.summary: High-severity journal of landing the spreadsheet-driven shipment operations workflow (server-side search, operational create/update fields, register actions, clerk dossier persistence) and the adversarial-review find that clearing cargoMode silently dropped the field instead of nulling it and its LCL dependents. Includes the switch from brittle Puppeteer login automation to seeding real JWTs for browser QA.

nodes.name: 260801-new-flow-default.md
nodes.summary: Journal of removing the old rollout compatibility layer so the customer-service-to-finance flow is the only runtime path, and of the test coupling it exposed: chiho-reconciliation FK teardown ordering and durable-effect-jobs asserting a global singleton. Records the API/UI queue mismatch behind the first E2E failure and an honest full-E2E-still-pending status.

nodes.name: 260803-1758-shipment-milestone-table-overflow.md
nodes.summary: Layout journal for the /shipments desktop table where a long next-milestone label painted past the delivery cell into the status column; the fix renders the milestone once with a title tooltip and an ellipsized two-line split, contained in CSS. Documents the red-green test sequence and Puppeteer geometry evidence showing zero document overflow at 1920, 1024, and 390 pixel widths.

nodes.name: 260804-1920-cus-shipment-closeout-qa-setback.md
nodes.summary: QA-concurrency journal from the CUS shipment workspace delivery (seven-tab strip, required columns, missing-date warning, inline expected-delivery edit): a concurrent full backend pass rebuilt shared build output and restarted the watch process mid-E2E, contaminating the signal. Lesson: serialize backend QA before E2E and treat overlapping runs as invalid.

nodes.name: 260813-1730-cus-readonly-container-detail.md
nodes.summary: Journal of the CUS shipment master boundary rework: the dedicated Chi tiet track was removed so row activation opens a read-only container ledger, with Chinh sua as the explicit edit transition and confirm-before-discard safeguards for unsaved edits. Lists ShipmentsPage tests and the two CUS workspace E2E suites among touchpoints, with 640 frontend tests and 21/21 plus 54/54 E2E results.

nodes.name: 260813-2308-cus-create-e2e-concurrency-setback.md
nodes.summary: Setback journal for a red CUS create-screen full E2E run caused by a Playwright navigation-context race, connection refusals to the local :3001 backend, and a concurrent CUS workspace KeyError('factVersion'). Decision: keep the red artifact authoritative, claim no E2E success, and rerun under a stable backend with no concurrent modifying activity.

nodes.name: 260814-2224-shipment-create-page-containment.md
nodes.summary: Technical journal consolidating shipment creation onto the canonical /shipments/new page, with two boundary lessons: native select options can force grid-track overflow unless constrained at the grid item, and required trade direction must be enforced at the backend dispatch boundary, not only by the frontend form.

nodes.name: 260815-0030-cus-shipment-detail-workboard-lessons.md
nodes.summary: Lessons journal for the CUS shipment-detail workboard: container pagination and search made authoritative at the container query boundary, appointment semantics kept at shipment scope, and optimistic save conflicts returning 409 with refresh, remount, and explicit stale-draft disclosure. Also fixes cell-level content overflow rather than page-level only, and keeps a failed narrow-width E2E artifact visible as a real regression.

nodes.name: 260815-0155-governed-editable-grid-authorities.md
nodes.summary: Design journal for making the shipment tables editable like a spreadsheet without flattening persistence authorities: editors split at shipment, container, and approval boundaries under a seven-column visual grouping, container numbers canonicalized under the transaction lock, and a semantic split between draft-discarding 409 version conflicts and inline 400 validation that keeps the draft.

nodes.name: 260815-1250-dispatch-detail-ui-polish.md
nodes.summary: Presentation-only journal for the /dispatch/detailed-plan polish (dynamic identity Ke hoach chi tiet xe, labelled Vietnamese filters, responsive control sizing) with a review-caught nested filter CSS scope fix. Explicitly records that no business, RBAC, accounting-lock, or dispatch-order contract changed, and that mixed-carrier mutation and driver-notification walkthroughs remain open.

nodes.name: 260816-1110-dispatcher-resource-catalogs.md
nodes.summary: Engineering journal for the shipped DISPATCHER resource-catalog pages (commit a40aeed) recording four lessons: casbinAuthz('config') is an /api catch-all so one grant opens every mounted GET, backend pagination defaults silently break page math unless clients pin limit to pageSize, /api/catalogs/bootstrap lacks a Casbin gate, and pre-existing dirty trees bite at commit time. Lists open follow-up tickets.

nodes.languageNotes: Vietnamese; 52 sections organized as 8 feature groups each with 5-6 TC-M01-xx-xx cases plus an M01 acceptance table.

nodes.summary: Module 02 regression suite for pricing and non-transport revenue: fixed customer/route price lists, bulk-cargo weight-based tariffs, automatic revenue calculation from cargo weight, port lift/lower unit-price suggestions, and ancillary revenue tracking.
nodes.languageNotes: Vietnamese; smallest module suite at 122 non-empty lines, 5 feature groups with calculation-focused cases.

nodes.name: 04-module-04-disbursement-recovery.md
nodes.summary: Module 04 regression suite for the closed-loop disbursement/recovery flow: lot initiation by CUS or clerk, field-staff pending expenses, consolidating expenses from multiple staff onto one lot, accounting reconciliation and approval with maker-checker, debit-note generation and period locking, and classification of invoiced vs non-invoiced disbursements with the Q13/Q14 thresholds.
nodes.languageNotes: Vietnamese; cross-references business questions Q13/Q14 from the cross-cutting doc for expense thresholds and approval tiers.

nodes.name: 05-module-05-ar.md
nodes.summary: Module 05 (accounts receivable) regression suite covering customer debt tracking by debit note, aging classification, credit limits with 80%/100% warning thresholds and over-limit approval, freight-vs-disbursement debt separation, consolidated AR reports, payment allocation by trip or lot, automated dunning, and statement/debit-note export.
nodes.languageNotes: Vietnamese; uses a uniform 5-case pattern per feature (normal / no-data / boundary / change-exception-permission / retry-concurrency-consistency).

nodes.name: 06-module-06-ap.md
nodes.summary: Module 06 (accounts payable) regression suite covering fuel-debt tracking, extending payables to shipping lines, truckers, ports, warehouses and services, supplier invoice due-date and payment tracking with prepayment/overpayment handling, and bilateral debt offsetting.
nodes.languageNotes: Vietnamese; includes the customer-is-also-supplier (Q08) edge cases for two-way offsetting.

nodes.name: 07-module-07-payroll.md
nodes.summary: Module 07 regression suite for driver payroll and HR: automatic per-trip/base/waiting-day salary calculation, attendance calendars by day type, pay-period closing with labor-cost accounting and controlled reopening, and discipline/deduction management with threshold-based approval tiers.
nodes.languageNotes: Vietnamese; period-close semantics (Q10/Q11) tested explicitly — errors block close, post-close changes require adjustment entries.

nodes.name: 08-module-08-driver-app.md

nodes.languageNotes: Vietnamese; mobile-specific cases include OS font scaling, landscape rotation, slow network, and safe offline queuing.

nodes.name: 09-module-09-field-app.md

nodes.languageNotes: Vietnamese; emphasis on multi-user concurrent submissions and partial-return settlement of shared expenses.

nodes.name: 10-module-10-clerk-app.md

nodes.name: 11-module-11-finance-pnl.md

nodes.languageNotes: Vietnamese; section 11.6 tests the AI assistant including voice input, timezone-sensitive relative dates, and permission-scoped answers.

nodes.name: 12-module-12-fuel.md

nodes.languageNotes: Vietnamese; closed trips must not recalculate when norm configuration changes later — consistency is asserted explicitly.

nodes.summary: Applies an analyzed master-import batch via POST /:id/apply with the expected version and an idempotency key, logging per-sheet applied counts.

nodes.name: resolveIds
nodes.summary: Lists customers, sites, fleet, drivers, ports, container types, and cargo types from the API and resolves them to canonical IDs via normalized-name and license-plate matching, hard-failing with diagnostics when a lookup is ambiguous or missing.

nodes.name: createShipment
nodes.summary: POSTs a single shipment payload to /api/shipments with an idempotency key, dying with the full error body on failure.

nodes.name: attachContainer
nodes.summary: Attaches a container to a shipment through the versioned container endpoint, passing expectedVersion for optimistic concurrency.

nodes.name: createShipments
nodes.summary: Builds the four real demo shipments from the dispatch workbook — skipping shipments that already exist by booking reference — creating each one and attaching its two containers with full debit-note pricing.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Pipeline driver: ensures the cleaned workbook exists, logs in as admin, conditionally uploads and applies master data, resolves canonical IDs, and creates the demo shipments.

tour.title: Project Entry Points & Server Bootstrap
tour.description: Start where the application comes alive: the Express API server (backend/src/index.ts) initializes middleware, routes, and database connections; the React SPA bootstrap (frontend/src/main.tsx) sets up the root component and router. These two files are the execution roots from which all other modules load.

tour.title: Backend API Routing & Middleware
tour.description: The HTTP surface layer: Express 5 route definitions in backend/src/routes/ expose the REST API contracts, while middleware in backend/src/middleware/ implements cross-cutting concerns—JWT/Casbin authentication (auth.ts, casbin.ts), audit logging (audit.ts), error handling, and idempotency guards. Understand how requests flow from HTTP into domain logic.

tour.title: Database Schema & Persistence Layer
tour.description: The data model foundation: Drizzle ORM schema in backend/src/db/schema.ts defines all tables, relations, and constraints. The 18 SQL migrations in backend/drizzle/ capture the evolutionary history of schema changes. This layer determines what state can be persisted and how domain entities map to storage.

tour.title: Dispatch Planning Domain (Core Differentiator)
tour.description: The heart of the logistics system: dispatch-planning.service.ts orchestrates vehicle allocation, route optimization, and carrier assignment. Frontend modules in frontend/src/features/dispatch/ provide the planning UI with master/detailed plan grids, filters, and allocation workflows. This subsystem is the key operational differentiator.

tour.title: Shipment & CUS Workspace Domain
tour.description: Customer-facing shipment operations: cus-shipment-workspace.service.ts manages the container appointment workflow for CUS (Vietnam customs). The shipment intake, fulfillment, and coordination services handle lifecycle transitions. Frontend shipment creation and detail pages provide the operator interface.

tour.title: Governance & Approval Workflows
tour.description: The maker-checker-approver pattern governing financial writes: governance-policy.ts, approval.service.ts, and the governance-actions route implement three-person approval queues for price configs, debit notes, and financial adjustments. ADMIN self-approval bypass is a key security pattern. Frontend governance pages show the approval queue.

tour.title: Financial Services & Domain Logic
tour.description: Core financial operations: billing-document-governance.service.ts, debit-note-lifecycle.service.ts, receivables-report.service.ts, and the profit distribution logic. These services implement revenue recognition, receivable tracking, and profitability attribution—the business logic backbone.

tour.title: Agent/LLM Integration Layer
tour.description: AI assistant capabilities: The agent/ subdirectory implements intent routing, tool selection, and semantic data retrieval. Key files include orchestrator.ts, intent-router.ts, and tool.selector.ts. This layer connects the system to LLM providers (OpenRouter, MiniMax) for FAQ answering and financial overview generation.

tour.title: Frontend Feature Modules
tour.description: UI composition layer: Feature-scoped modules in frontend/src/features/ organize dispatch components, trip detail cards, fleet management, and workspace UIs. Each feature bundles components, hooks, and co-located styles. These modules compose into the pages that users interact with.

tour.title: Frontend Components & Shared Hooks
tour.description: Reusable UI building blocks: Components in frontend/src/components/ (layout, billing, charts, shared primitives) and hooks in frontend/src/hooks/ provide the foundational React patterns. API clients in frontend/src/api/ deliver typed HTTP contracts. This is the shared toolkit from which features are built.

tour.title: Test Suites & Verification
tour.description: Quality assurance: Backend Vitest tests in backend/src/tests/ cover routes, services, and governance contracts. Frontend co-located tests validate components and pages. E2E Playwright specs in e2e/ verify user workflows. These tests encode the system's behavioral contracts and guard against regressions.

tour.title: Infrastructure & Configuration
tour.description: Deployment foundations: The config loader in backend/src/config/, scheduler registry for recurring jobs, and shared libraries (lib/format.ts, lib/redis.ts, lib/telemetry.ts) provide the runtime infrastructure. This layer wires up external dependencies and determines how the system runs in production.
